formaldehyde.zh: 甲醛（一種有刺鼻氣味的化學物質）
ai: Formaldehyde has a sharp smell that irritates the eyes and nose.
甲醛有刺鼻的氣味，會刺激眼睛和鼻子。
New furniture can release small amounts of formaldehyde into the air.
新家具可能會向空氣中釋放少量甲醛。

idyll.zh: 田園詩；寧靜美好的田園生活
ai: Their life in the small village was a perfect idyll.
他們在小村莊的生活宛如一幅完美的田園畫。
The poet wrote an idyll about shepherds and green hills.
詩人寫了一首描寫牧羊人與青山的田園詩。
The fox used every wile to escape the hunters.
狐狸用盡各種詭計想擺脫獵人。
She got the job through charm and a few clever wiles.
她靠魅力和一些小聰明得到了這份工作。
He tried to wile her into signing the contract.
他想哄騙她簽下那份合約。
We wiled away the afternoon playing cards.
我們玩牌消磨了一個下午。
Safety is our watchword on every construction site.
安全是我們每個工地的口號。
The guard asked for the watchword before opening the gate.
守衛在開門前要求對方說出口令。
My brother is such a slob that his room is always a mess.
我弟弟是個邋遢鬼，房間總是亂七八糟。
Don't be a slob and put your dirty dishes in the sink.
別這麼邋遢，把髒碗盤放進水槽。
It was an unthinking remark and she regretted it at once.
那是一句不經思考的話，她馬上就後悔了。
He gave an unthinking nod without reading the contract.
他連合約都沒看就不假思索地點了頭。
The cook trussed the chicken with string before roasting it.
廚師在烤雞之前用棉線把雞綁好。
They trussed the boxes tightly so nothing would fall off the truck.
他們把箱子綁緊，免得東西從卡車上掉下來。

truss.zh: 桁架（支撐屋頂或橋樑的框架）
ai: The roof is held up by a wooden truss.
屋頂由木製桁架支撐著。
Engineers checked every steel truss on the old bridge.
工程師檢查了舊橋上的每一根鋼桁架。
The technical manual is hard for the uninitiated to understand.
這份技術手冊對外行人來說很難懂。
To the uninitiated, the game's rules seem very confusing.
對沒接觸過的人來說，這個遊戲的規則看起來很混亂。
A straight line bisects the circle into two equal halves.
一條直線把圓分成相等的兩半。
The river bisects the town, with a bridge at each end.
河流把小鎮劈成兩半，兩端各有一座橋。
I prefer tea without sweetened milk.
我喜歡不加甜牛奶的茶。
The label says this drink is sweetened with honey.
標籤上寫這款飲料是用蜂蜜加甜的。
I was shocked by his rudeness to the waiter.
他對服務生的無禮讓我很震驚。
Rudeness is never an acceptable way to win an argument.
粗魯無禮絕不是贏得爭論的好方法。
They shared a long, wordless hug at the station.
他們在車站無言地擁抱了很久。
The film is almost wordless, telling its story through images.
這部電影幾乎沒有台詞，靠畫面來說故事。
We took the turnpike and paid a toll at every exit.
我們走收費公路，每個出口都要付過路費。
Traffic on the turnpike was slow because of the holiday.
因為假期，收費公路上的車流很慢。
The author created a fictive town for her novel.
作者為她的小說創造了一座虛構的小鎮。
Children often invent fictive friends to play with.
孩子常常會想像出虛擬的朋友來一起玩。
The shipyard will refit the old boat with a new engine.
造船廠會為這艘老船換上新引擎。
They refitted the shop to make room for a café.
他們改裝了店面，騰出空間開咖啡廳。
The ship went in for a complete refit last winter.
這艘船去年冬天進廠做了全面整修。
The refit of the old factory took six months.
舊工廠的改裝花了六個月。
The speed of the trip is inversely related to the time it takes.
旅程的速度與所需時間成反比。
Prices rose, and inversely, demand fell.
價格上漲，相反地，需求下降了。

psych.zh: （psych up）替自己打氣；做好心理準備
ai: I need a few minutes to psych up before the interview.
面試前我需要幾分鐘替自己打氣。
The coach tried to psych up the team before the final game.
教練在決賽前努力幫球隊鼓舞士氣。
The store sells clothes for preteen girls.
這家店販售青春期前女孩的衣服。
She teaches a class for preteen kids on Saturdays.
她週六教一個給青春期前孩子的課程。

preteen.zh: 青春期前的孩子（約十到十二歲）
ai: My sister is a preteen who loves reading comics.
我妹妹是個愛看漫畫的小學高年級生。
The show is popular with preteens and their parents.
這個節目很受青春期前的孩子和家長歡迎。
He is a professed fan of old movies.
他公開表示自己是老電影的粉絲。
Her professed love of nature didn't stop her from littering.
她口口聲聲說熱愛大自然，卻還是亂丟垃圾。
The doctor said his chest pain was caused by angina.
醫生說他的胸痛是心絞痛引起的。
People with angina should avoid heavy exercise.
有心絞痛的人應避免劇烈運動。
His speech was full of empty platitudes about hard work.
他的演講充滿了關於努力的空洞老調。
"Time heals all wounds" is a platitude, not a comfort.
「時間會治癒一切」是句老套話，並不能安慰人。
Some say the future is unknowable.
有人說未來是無法預知的。
The exact cause of the fire remains unknowable.
這場火災的確切原因依舊無從得知。
The children showed great inventiveness in building their fort.
孩子們在搭建他們的小堡壘時展現出很強的創造力。
Her inventiveness helped the team solve the problem quickly.
她的創意幫助團隊很快解決了問題。
In wintertime the whole village is covered in snow.
到了冬天，整個村莊都覆蓋著白雪。
I love drinking hot soup in wintertime.
我喜歡在冬天喝熱湯。

inimitable.zh: 無法模仿的；獨一無二的
ai: The singer has an inimitable voice that everyone recognizes.
這位歌手有獨特到無法模仿的嗓音，大家一聽就認得。
He told the story in his own inimitable style.
他用自己獨一無二的風格說了這個故事。
The report misstated the company's profits for last year.
這份報告錯誤陳述了公司去年的利潤。
He misstated the facts and later had to apologize.
他說錯了事實，後來不得不道歉。
A white egret stood still in the shallow water.
一隻白鷺靜靜站在淺水裡。
We saw several egrets resting in the rice fields.
我們看到幾隻白鷺在稻田裡休息。

deadbeat.zh: 賴帳的人；遊手好閒的人
ai: He is a deadbeat who never pays back what he owes.
他是個欠錢不還的賴皮。
Her landlord called the deadbeat tenants again about the rent.
房東又打電話給那些不繳房租的房客。

foregone.zh: 預先決定的；早已註定的
ai: The result of the match was a foregone conclusion.
這場比賽的結果早已是定局。
With such a big lead, victory seemed foregone.
領先這麼多，勝利似乎已經註定。

demure.zh: 端莊嫻靜的；裝出害羞模樣的
ai: She gave a demure smile and lowered her eyes.
她露出端莊的微笑，低下了眼睛。
The girl in the portrait looks quiet and demure.
畫像中的女孩看起來安靜又嫻靜。
His flippant answer annoyed the teacher.
他輕率的回答惹惱了老師。
Don't be flippant about such a serious matter.
對這麼嚴肅的事別這麼隨便。
The students accused the teacher of showing favouritism.
學生指責老師偏心。
Hiring a friend without an interview is clear favouritism.
沒面試就僱用朋友顯然是徇私。

constructed.zh: 建造；構成（construct 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The workers constructed a small bridge over the stream.
工人在小溪上建了一座小橋。
The house was constructed entirely of wood.
這棟房子完全是用木頭建造的。

dispassionate.zh: 冷靜客觀的；不帶感情的
ai: A judge must make a dispassionate decision based on the facts.
法官必須依事實做出客觀冷靜的判斷。
She gave a dispassionate account of the accident.
她冷靜地敘述了事故經過。
The bad news caused great perturbation in the office.
壞消息讓辦公室裡人心惶惶。
Small perturbations can change the path of a planet.
微小的擾動就能改變行星的軌道。
The pipe disgorged dirty water onto the street.
水管把髒水噴到街上。
The court ordered the company to disgorge its illegal profits.
法院命令這家公司交出非法所得。
She threw the old letters into the wastebasket.
她把舊信件丟進廢紙簍。
There is a small wastebasket under my desk.
我的書桌下有一個小廢紙簍。

complicating.zh: 使複雜化（complicate 的現在分詞）
ai: You are complicating a very simple problem.
你把一個很簡單的問題複雜化了。
Heavy rain kept complicating our travel plans.
大雨不斷讓我們的旅行計畫變得更複雜。
Diffraction makes light spread out after it passes through a narrow gap.
光通過狹窄縫隙後會因為繞射而散開。
Sound diffraction lets you hear someone around a corner.
聲音的繞射讓你能聽見轉角另一邊的人說話。
Her cheerfulness made the whole class feel happier.
她的開朗讓全班都跟著快樂起來。
He greeted everyone with great cheerfulness.
他興高采烈地向每個人打招呼。
He is trying to reduce his waistline by walking every day.
他試著每天走路來縮小腰圍。
The dress has a high waistline and a long skirt.
這件洋裝是高腰設計，搭配長裙。
Drink water during the hike to maintain good hydration.
健行時要喝水，維持身體水分充足。
Proper hydration is important for athletes in hot weather.
天氣炎熱時，充足的水分補給對運動員很重要。

filled.zh: 裝滿；填滿（fill 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: She filled the glass with cold water.
她把玻璃杯倒滿冷水。
The room was filled with laughter.
房間裡充滿了笑聲。
He walked in with a bag filled with groceries.
他提著一袋裝滿食材的袋子走進來。
The stadium was filled with excited fans.
體育場裡擠滿了興奮的球迷。

unsophisticated.zh: 單純的；不世故的；簡陋的
ai: He was an unsophisticated young man from a small town.
他是來自小鎮、單純不世故的年輕人。
The tools they used were simple and unsophisticated.
他們使用的工具既簡單又粗糙。
The farmer checked the almanac for the best planting dates.
農夫翻閱曆書，找最適合播種的日子。
The almanac lists the times of sunrise and sunset.
這本年鑑列出了日出和日落的時間。
The javelin thrower practiced every morning before school.
這位標槍選手每天上學前都練習。
He is the best knife thrower in the circus.
他是馬戲團裡最厲害的擲飛刀表演者。

unobserved.zh: 沒被注意到的；未被察覺的
ai: She slipped out of the room unobserved.
她沒被人發現地溜出了房間。
The small change went unobserved for several years.
這個小變化好幾年都沒人注意到。
Ignore the haters and keep doing what you love.
別理那些酸民，繼續做你喜歡的事。
He has a few haters online who leave mean comments.
他在網路上有幾個酸民，常留下刻薄的留言。
The movie's ending was trite and easy to guess.
這部電影的結局老套，很容易猜到。
It may sound trite, but honesty really is the best policy.
這聽起來也許老套，但誠實真的是上策。
His arraignment is scheduled for Monday morning.
他的提審排在週一早上。
At the arraignment, the man pleaded not guilty.
在提審時，該名男子表示不認罪。
The placenta supplies food and oxygen to the baby.
胎盤為胎兒提供養分和氧氣。
The doctor checked that the placenta was healthy.
醫生確認胎盤狀況良好。
The reintroduction of wolves changed the forest ecosystem.
狼的重新引進改變了森林的生態系。
Fans welcomed the reintroduction of the classic flavor.
粉絲歡迎這款經典口味重新上市。
The company saw a threefold increase in sales this year.
公司今年的銷售額成長了三倍。
The plan has a threefold purpose.
這項計畫有三個目的。
Their profits rose threefold after the new product launched.
新產品上市後，他們的利潤增加了三倍。
The number of visitors has grown threefold since last year.
來訪人數比去年成長了三倍。
She got vicarious pleasure from her son's success.
她從兒子的成功中得到間接的喜悅。
Reading travel books gave him vicarious adventures.
讀旅遊書讓他間接體驗了各種冒險。
Most toothpaste contains fluoride to protect teeth.
大多數牙膏含有氟化物來保護牙齒。
Some cities add fluoride to their drinking water.
有些城市會在飲用水中添加氟化物。
We need goals that are clear and quantifiable.
我們需要明確又可量化的目標。
The damage from the storm was hard to make quantifiable.
這場風暴造成的損失很難用數字衡量。
The judge refused to accept such a perverted view of justice.
法官拒絕接受這種扭曲的正義觀。
His perverted sense of humor made everyone uneasy.
他那不正常的幽默感讓大家很不自在。

unencumbered.zh: 不受阻礙的；沒有負擔的
ai: She traveled light and unencumbered by heavy bags.
她輕裝上路，不用拖著沉重的行李。
He wanted a house unencumbered by debt.
他想要一棟沒有負債的房子。
The deserter ran away from the army during the night.
那名逃兵在夜裡逃離了軍隊。
Nobody trusted him after he was called a deserter.
自從他被稱為逃兵後，沒人再信任他。

mystified.zh: 使困惑（mystify 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: Her sudden silence mystified everyone at the table.
她突然沉默，讓桌上每個人都摸不著頭腦。
We were mystified by the strange sound from the attic.
我們對閣樓傳來的怪聲感到困惑不解。
We walked along an unlit road in the dark.
我們在黑暗中走過一條沒有路燈的路。
The candles on the cake were still unlit.
蛋糕上的蠟燭還沒點燃。
The inspector examined the document minutely.
檢查員仔細地審視了這份文件。
The plans were minutely detailed, down to every screw.
計畫詳細到連每顆螺絲都有交代。
Small boats fish in the inshore waters near the harbor.
小船在靠近港口的近岸海域捕魚。
An inshore wind pushed the waves toward the beach.
吹向陸地的風把浪推向海灘。
The fishing boats sailed inshore before the storm.
漁船在暴風雨前駛向岸邊。
Dolphins sometimes swim inshore in the morning.
海豚有時早上會游到靠近海岸的地方。
He is the progenitor of a large family in this region.
他是這個地區一個大家族的祖先。
The old game was the progenitor of many modern ones.
這款老遊戲是許多現代遊戲的始祖。

surging.zh: 洶湧；急遽上升（surge 的現在分詞）
ai: Crowds were surging toward the stage when the band appeared.
樂團一出場，人群就湧向舞台。
Prices keep surging because of the shortage.
因為短缺，物價持續飆升。
The speaker placed his notes on the lectern.
演講者把講稿放在講台上。
She walked up to the lectern and adjusted the microphone.
她走到講台前，調整了麥克風。
He wanted to escape his humdrum office job.
他想擺脫那份單調乏味的辦公室工作。
Life in the small town felt humdrum to her.
她覺得小鎮的生活很平淡無聊。
She spoke in a low, throaty voice after the cold.
感冒後，她用低沉沙啞的聲音說話。
The old engine made a throaty roar.
那台老引擎發出低沉的轟鳴聲。

cathartic.zh: 宣洩情緒的；使人釋放的
ai: Writing in a diary can be a cathartic experience.
寫日記可以是一種宣洩情緒的經驗。
She found a good cry surprisingly cathartic.
她發現痛哭一場意外地讓人釋懷。
The guests arrived at the ball in their finest finery.
賓客們穿著最華麗的服飾來到舞會。
She put on her finery for the wedding.
她穿上盛裝去參加婚禮。
Violence often begets more violence.
暴力往往會引來更多暴力。
In the old story, the king begot three sons.
在古老的故事裡，國王生了三個兒子。

escapade.zh: 冒險的惡作劇；越軌行為
ai: They laughed about their wild escapade from college days.
他們笑談大學時代那次瘋狂的冒險。
His latest escapade got him into trouble with the school.
他最近的胡鬧讓他惹上了學校的麻煩。
The kids burst into laughter at the silliness of the game.
孩子們被這個遊戲的傻氣逗得哈哈大笑。
Enough silliness, let's get back to work.
別鬧了，我們回去工作吧。
The teacher was tired of the students' shenanigans.
老師受夠了學生們的胡鬧。
The company was caught in financial shenanigans.
這家公司被抓到在財務上耍花招。
The archeologist carefully brushed dirt off the old pot.
考古學家小心地刷掉古老陶罐上的泥土。
An archeologist found coins buried near the temple.
一位考古學家在寺廟附近發現了埋藏的錢幣。
The clerk courteously answered all our questions.
店員有禮貌地回答了我們所有的問題。
He bowed courteously and held the door open.
他客氣地鞠躬並替我們扶著門。
We ordered chicken enchiladas with a spicy red sauce.
我們點了淋上辣紅醬的雞肉墨西哥捲餅。
She rolled the tortillas into enchiladas and baked them.
她把玉米餅捲成墨西哥捲餅後拿去烤。
After much ado, they finally found the lost keys.
一陣忙亂之後，他們終於找到了遺失的鑰匙。
Without further ado, let's start the show.
不再多說廢話，我們開始表演吧。
The government trains hospitals to respond to bioterrorism.
政府訓練醫院如何因應生物恐怖攻擊。
Experts discussed how to prevent bioterrorism.
專家們討論了如何預防生物恐怖主義。

hobo.zh: 流浪漢；四處打零工的人
ai: The old hobo slept on a bench near the train station.
那位老流浪漢睡在火車站附近的長椅上。
In the story, a hobo shares his bread with a stray dog.
故事裡，一名流浪漢把麵包分給一隻流浪狗。

heuristic.zh: 啟發式的；憑經驗摸索的
ai: Teachers use a heuristic approach to help students find answers.
老師用啟發式的方法幫助學生自己找答案。
This heuristic method is quick but not always exact.
這種啟發式方法很快，但不一定精確。
A simple heuristic is to start with the easiest problem.
一個簡單的經驗法則是從最容易的問題開始。
Programmers use heuristics when an exact solution takes too long.
當精確解法耗時太久時，程式設計師會用啟發式演算法。

posturing.zh: 擺姿態；裝腔作勢（posture 的現在分詞）
ai: The politicians kept posturing instead of solving the problem.
政客們一直在擺姿態，而不是解決問題。
The two boys were posturing in front of the girls.
兩個男孩在女孩們面前擺架子。
Our beagle follows every smell down the street.
我們家的米格魯會循著每一種氣味一路走在街上。
The beagle has long floppy ears and a loud bark.
米格魯有長長的垂耳和響亮的叫聲。
One company has a stranglehold on the local market.
有一家公司牢牢壟斷了當地市場。
High rent has a stranglehold on small businesses in the city.
高額租金扼住了這個城市小商家的生計。
